workflow: A comparison traverses shared associative state while retaining borrowed references to its containers, keys, and values.
Comparing an element invokes user-defined behavior that re-enters and mutates one of the containers.
The mutation releases or replaces storage still referenced by the active comparison.
The comparison resumes using those stale references, causing a use-after-free and process-terminating failure.
summary: Reentrant comparison invalidates active container references
